name: Deep Link Builder
blurb: a deep link from scheme and parameters, with the emulator test command
intro: Builds a deep link from its scheme, host, path and parameters with RFC 3986 percent-encoding, and gives the adb and simctl commands that open it on an emulator, the Android intent filter and, for https links, the assetlinks.json and apple-app-site-association files.

inputs.label: Host
inputs.help: For https: your domain. For a custom scheme: optional, often the screen name.

examples.title: A product screen from a campaign
A verified https link to an order

usage: Give kind (scheme or https), scheme (for custom schemes), host, path, params as rows of {key, value} (raw, unencoded), an optional fragment, the Android package pkg and the iOS bundle id (and Apple team id for https). It returns the encoded link, its parts as typed and as encoded, and texts: the adb am start and xcrun simctl openurl commands, a Chrome intent: link, the Android intent filter, and either the iOS CFBundleURLTypes entry or the assetlinks.json and apple-app-site-association files. Use it to test a deep link on an emulator or to set one up.
